summary: Every course must be letter graded where a letter grade is offered. You pick a subplan: Environmental Behavioral Science checks the theory and methods cores (COMM 318 for 5 units), four Advanced Theory courses totaling 10 units (not directed reading, the workshop, teaching or research units), the data, ecology and advanced methods courses, and two quarters of EBS 298 and six of EBS 300; Global Environmental Policy checks one causal inference sequence (ECON or POLISCI), CS 229, GEP 268 and 269, the economics sequence, the four policy courses (GEP 215, 305, 347 and 365) and GEP 300, with the deep learning course and the advisor-chosen science or engineering and elective sequences moved in by hand. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, and the department records teaching, the research plan, annual reviews, candidacy, the qualifying exam, the oral exam and the dissertation.
